reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: syncRoles is a live HTTP handler registered at index.ts:68 (POST /api/roles/sync) with at least one non-test caller. Gate 2: No trust_assumptions defined in BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json — gate cannot trigger. Gate 3: src/api/ is explicitly in scope. An attacker with a valid API bearer token can trigger this via POST /api/roles/sync by supplying the discord_uid of a member who leads multiple teams; .single() at rolesSync.ts:117 returns null when 2+ team_leaders rows match, causing the else-branch (L126-130) to remove the leader Discord role from a legitimately-eligible member. Severity held at Medium: impact is incorrect privilege removal (leader role stripped), affecting only members with 2+ team_leaders entries; no privilege escalation or data exfiltration.
reviewed_items.spec_reference: SG-004_syncRoles — post: syncRoles(uid) => member.has_role(leader) iff uid in team_leaders
